notes: TechLog now works with Fenix Version 3 (3.0.0.7426). The failures Fenix V3 renamed or removed (IDG oil, brakes, nose tyres, TCAS, FCDC) use V3's names again.

Brakes are tracked wheel by wheel: carbon oxidation, release mechanism and piston seals, aged by hot brakes, plus the brake valves, tachometers, fans and indicators. New parts for IDG oil level and filter, cabin systems (CIDS), water and waste, zone trim and skin air valves, and engine oil pressure switches.

A failed valve that is deferred under the MEL is shown secured open or closed in the Fenix. Settings now has a Fix button that puts TechLog's tablet app back in the Community folder after an update removes it.
Checked against a running Fenix V3 (data link, all cockpit switches, the takeoff and landing calculators). Not seen yet: a whole flight on V3 and the new failures set in the Fenix.
